Mirc Glow Glass Glow Cream is our most advanced cream for a glass skin glow. It brings together five well-known skincare ingredients in one 30 g jar: glutathione, niacinamide, hyaluronic acid, centella asiatica and alpha arbutin. The cream is soft, pale green and easy to spread, and it suits a simple Korean-style routine, especially at night.

Key ingredients: glutathione, niacinamide (vitamin B3), hyaluronic acid, centella asiatica and alpha arbutin. The full ingredient list is printed on the box.

Glass Glow Cream benefits

  • Helps skin look radiant, smooth and more even
  • Helps dark spots and patches look less noticeable with regular use and daily sunscreen
  • Hydrates for a plump, dewy, "glass skin" look
  • Helps pores look smaller and texture look smoother
  • Centella gives a calm, comfortable skin feel
  • Five targeted ingredients in one step, instead of several serums

How to use Glass Glow Cream

  1. Wash your face with a gentle cleanser and pat dry.
  2. If you use a serum or toner, apply it first and let it settle.
  3. Take a pea-sized amount and dot it on the forehead, cheeks, nose and chin.
  4. Spread gently upwards over the face and neck until it is absorbed.
  5. Use it at night as your last step. If you also use it in the morning, always finish with sunscreen.

Patch test behind the ear or on the jawline for 24 to 48 hours before the first full use. Most people notice softer, more hydrated skin within days; a more even-looking tone usually takes 8 to 12 weeks of regular use with sunscreen every day.

Which skin types is it for?

Dull or uneven-looking skin: the main reason people choose it.

Normal, combination and oily skin: a pea-sized amount is enough; the texture is light.

Dry skin: hyaluronic acid helps, and you can layer a richer cream such as our Avocado Night Cream on very dry nights.

Sensitive skin: start every second night after a patch test.

Product FAQs

What is in Mirc Glow Glass Glow Cream?

Its key ingredients are glutathione, niacinamide, hyaluronic acid, centella asiatica and alpha arbutin. The full list is printed on the box.

Is Glass Glow Cream a glutathione cream?

Yes. Glutathione is its hero ingredient, supported by four other ingredients for hydration, texture and a more even-looking tone.

Can I use it every day?

Yes, after a patch test. Use it every night, and if you use it in the morning too, always apply sunscreen on top.

When will I see results?

Skin usually feels softer and more hydrated within days. A more radiant, even-looking tone usually takes 8 to 12 weeks of regular use with daily sunscreen. Results vary from person to person.

Does it change natural skin colour?

No. It helps skin look brighter, smoother and more even, but it does not change your natural skin tone.

Can men use it?

Yes. It suits women and men.

How long does a 30 g jar last?

About 6 to 8 weeks at a pea-sized amount each night.

Is Glass Glow Cream good for oily skin?

Yes. The texture is light, so a pea-sized amount at night suits oily and combination skin; use less in humid weather.

Can I use Glass Glow Cream with other night creams?

Yes. On very dry nights, apply Glass Glow Cream first and a thin layer of a richer cream such as the Avocado Night Cream on dry areas, or choose the Glass Glow Night Duo.

Is Mirc Glow Glass Glow Cream a Korean product?

It is Korean-inspired and made in India, built around the glass-skin idea of a hydrated, smooth, even-looking finish.

This is a cosmetic cream, not a medicine. See a dermatologist for any skin condition or for spots that change quickly.
